about: Copies in stock that are the same work under titles in different languages, when no shared work record (original_year_ref) links them yet. Read by app.same_work_copy (AUDFIX 2026-11-05, Codex audit P2): a copy in the visitor's language takes another copy's place only when the two are proven the same work, never for the same author and year alone. Each entry: the work record, the author as written on our copies, the titles of our copies, and the source that names them (BOARD.md rule 12). The author link in our records is still required.
